name: SIN-Bench
description:
SIN-Bench（及 SIN-Data）
	

本仓库在 Hugging Face 上发布 SIN-Bench（评测任务）。This Hugging Face repo hosts SIN-Bench (benchmark tasks).

GitHub（代码与说明 / code）: https://github.com/IIGROUP/sin-bench  
Paper（arXiv）: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10108

SIN-Bench 强调“可追溯证据链”：不仅要回答，还要给出可定位到论文原文图文证据的 evidence chain。SIN-Bench emphasizes traceable evidence chains grounded in native interleaved scientific content.


	
		
	
	
		任务 / Tasks
	


FIND：寻找支持问题/结论的证据链Find an evidence chain supporting the question/claim.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/IIGroup/SIN-Bench.
evaluation_method: precision/recall for retrieved evidence chains plus human evaluation of chain correctness and sufficiency
general_score_metric: precision/recall of evidence retrieval (augmented by human evaluation scores)
reputation: A recent benchmark emphasizing traceable, paper-grounded evidence chains for scientific claims; gaining interest among researchers focused on scientific QA, fact-checking, and explainability.
